The round-2 build failed typecheck and test on a tree where ajv resolves
to the 6.15.0 hoisted at node_modules/ajv by main's lock rather than the
8.20.0 this branch's lock installs. Neither prior import form survives
both majors: a default import is TS2351 under ajv 8 NodeNext, a named
import is TS2693 under ajv 6's export=, and ajv 6 spells the validation
error path dataPath. Resolve the constructor off the namespace with a
default fallback, read the error path under either spelling, and let the
wrong-type assertion accept both wordings. Proven locally against both
installed trees with a scoped tsc of the two files and 30 tests across
registry.test.ts and chatOrchestrator.test.ts; spec anchors re-pinned to
the shifted test lines.
